intended_object: The standard generating set of the Markoff group Γ acting on the Markoff surface X: x²+y²+z² = 3xyz over a commutative ring R. It consists of the three Vieta involutions and two adjacent coordinate transpositions, which together generate S₃. Inferred from the docstring, the module documentation and its use in `Gamma R = Subgroup.closure (gammaGenerators R)`.
explanation: The set contains the Vieta involutions x_i ↦ 3x_jx_k − x_i, which swap a coordinate with the other root of the Markoff quadratic, and the transpositions (12) and (23). Each is restricted to the surface {x₁²+x₂²+x₃² − 3x₁x₂x₃ = 0}, using the proofs that it preserves the equation. The group these elements generate is exactly the Markoff group of BGS: all coordinate permutations plus the Vieta moves. Working over an arbitrary commutative ring is the natural generality. Mathlib has no Markoff surface or Markoff group.
